pages.text: Melons form, cane grows another whole segment, and trunks and leaves unfold. Small mushrooms spread on their own.$(br2)These plant materials share one mimic. Huge mushroom blocks, which require bonemeal to grow, follow a different pattern.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Dirt$(br)Water Bucket$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Sequence and Delay$(br)Rune Plate: Numbers and Chance$(br)Rune Plate: Repetition and Sustain

pages.title: Choose a Material
pages.text: Use any material in this family as the reference when shaping the common mimic.$(br2)Craft that mimic together with a matching block, in either order, to select what it generates.$(br2)Craft the bound mimic alone to recover both the common mimic and the original material.
